notes.title: Update 4.08
notes.notes:
Small last minute update because I realized that hidden gold coins were not counted in a specific location if a specific action was not initiated.
So I had to change the number of gold coin piles in the backyard. (Behind the barracks)

notes.title: The Final Version of Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The game is almost ready so I'm updating the demo. I added 5 achievements, huge improvements and bug fixes.

[b]If the Saves are not deleted, delete them, there are a lot of changes and this could create bugs.
[/b]

I will come back to you soon to finally announce the release of the game which should see the light of day in May.
